Two: Three humans travel to the realm between realms, a dimension known as The City of Edges. There the trees and building compete for height. Of course, it’s never easy for Alvin and the trip spirals into having to do a lot more. Alvin and his friends must save the human realm from being completely swallowed by the forgotten.
